mentions.name: Gramps Web CLI tool
mentions.description: A command-line tool written in Go for interacting with a self-hosted Gramps Web genealogy service, enabling genealogy research and data management from the terminal while keeping ownership of one's own data instead of relying on hosted services like Ancestry.
mentions.audience: Existing genealogy services don't let users own their own data, and there's no CLI option for interacting with Gramps.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to finish up a command line tool in go to interface with my Gramps Web service.
